templates.name: Input Contract Schema Compliance
templates.description: Verify plan_package_final.json and required input artifacts conform to declared JSON schemas. Procedure: validate each artifact against its schema; confirm required fields present and types correct. Pass: 100% schema validation success; fail otherwise.

templates.name: Evidence Pointer Standard Enforcement
templates.description: Check all evidence references in decision/findings/trace artifacts use RFC 6901 JSON Pointer object {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}. Procedure: scan artifacts for evidence links; validate structure and pointer syntax; ensure artifact_ref exists. Pass: zero non-compliant evidence references.

templates.name: No Silent Scope Expansion
templates.description: Ensure no semantic changes to R#/AT#/O#/K# from input plan without ChangeRequest. Procedure: diff plan semantics referenced in outputs vs plan_package_final.json; check for ChangeRequest and decision record when deviations present. Pass: no deviations or approved ChangeRequest with decision record; fail otherwise.

templates.name: Patchset Deterministic Apply
templates.description: Validate patchsets are diff-only JSON artifacts with deterministic apply order and apply cleanly to base repo snapshot. Procedure: parse patchset format, apply in declared order to base_commit; confirm no conflicts and outputs match repo_snapshot.json. Pass: 100% clean apply and snapshot consistency.

templates.name: Forbidden/Protected Paths Enforcement
templates.description: Ensure patchsets do not modify forbidden/protected paths defined in repo_context.json. Procedure: compute changed paths from patchsets; compare against forbidden/protected patterns. Pass: zero forbidden writes; fail otherwise.

templates.name: Validator Gate Completeness
templates.description: Confirm required validators (build/test/lint/typecheck/integrity/workspace integrity/risk closure/reproducibility/trace completeness) are defined and executed with results captured. Procedure: verify test_results/quality_reports/trace_report include entries for each required gate and status. Pass: all gates present and status recorded.

templates.name: Freeze Bundle Required Artifacts
templates.description: Validate Implementation Freeze Bundle includes all mandatory artifacts and versions. Procedure: check artifact list for required files and presence in workspace_index; verify non-empty and schema-valid. Pass: all required artifacts present and valid.

templates.name: Audit Spine Immutability
templates.description: Verify run_manifest is immutable and event_log is append-only with ordered entries. Procedure: check event_log for monotonic sequence/timestamps and no deletions in provenance; ensure run_manifest referenced consistently. Pass: append-only sequence with no gaps or rewrites.

templates.name: Stage Handoff Coverage
templates.description: Ensure a stage_handoff artifact exists for every checkpoint boundary and contains required fields and evidence pointers. Procedure: enumerate stages from workflow; verify matching handoff artifacts; validate pointers. Pass: 100% coverage and valid structure.

templates.name: Workspace Index Integrity
templates.description: Confirm workspace_index accounts for all workspace artifacts, with types/versions/provenance. Procedure: cross-check workspace storage vs index entries; verify canonical vs non-canonical flags. Pass: 100% indexed items; no unindexed canonical artifacts.

templates.name: Secrets Redaction/Blocking
templates.description: Verify secrets policy enforcement across logs and workspace. Procedure: run secrets scan; check event_log/workspace artifacts for redaction markers; ensure blocking recorded for detected secrets. Pass: zero unredacted secrets persisted.

templates.name: Traceability to AT#
templates.description: Ensure test results map to AT# identifiers from plan_package_final.json. Procedure: verify test_results entries include AT# mapping and evidence pointers to plan_package_final.json. Pass: 100% tests mapped to AT# or explicitly justified exclusions.

templates.name: Review Findings Separation
templates.description: Verify reviewers produce findings-only artifacts with no writing/patch content. Procedure: scan review_findings.json for disallowed fields or patch content; ensure patches exist only in patchsets. Pass: findings-only compliance.

templates.name: ChangeRequest Governance
templates.description: If ChangeRequest present, verify approval/escalation recorded and policy-compliant before semantic changes applied. Procedure: validate ChangeRequest schema, decision record references, and stage ordering. Pass: approved ChangeRequest before any semantic deviation.

templates.name: Context Pack Determinism and Bounds
templates.description: Validate context packs are deterministically compiled, bounded, and reproducible. Procedure: check context_pack manifest for selection rules, size bounds, and referenced artifacts; recompute selection deterministically. Pass: deterministic match and within bounds.

coverage_guidance: Cover every required canonical artifact in the freeze bundle with at least one template-based check.
Ensure each policy constraint (CNS1–CNS13) has a measurable QA check mapped to an artifact.
Prioritize validation of evidence pointer compliance and no-silent-scope expansion early in the workflow.
Include both positive (presence/validity) and negative (absence of forbidden content) tests.
For each stage boundary, ensure a stage_handoff artifact exists and references latest canonical artifacts.
Verify deterministic behaviors: patchset apply order, context pack selection, and event log ordering.
Require schema validation for all JSON artifacts before content-level checks.
Trace tests to AT# identifiers and verify completeness or documented exclusions.
Check separation of powers by ensuring no artifacts claim authority reserved to orchestrator.
Verify secrets scanning and redaction outcomes are recorded in quality_reports with zero unredacted leaks.
Confirm review artifacts are findings-only and do not include patches or authored content.
Validate workspace index covers all canonical artifacts and distinguishes non-canonical items.
Ensure validator gate results are present and passing before freeze is allowed.
Require reproducibility evidence: rerun validators yields same outputs or recorded nondeterminism handling.
Enforce forbidden/protected path policies on patchsets with zero violations.
definition_of_done: All QA templates are applicable to at least one required artifact and describe a measurable pass/fail procedure.
Templates include checks for schema compliance, traceability, deterministic patch application, and gate completeness.
Coverage guidance maps to constraints and success metrics with no unaddressed critical areas.
DoD is met when a candidate freeze bundle passes all applicable templates with zero critical failures.
Any missing or ambiguous input contracts are flagged via ChangeRequest governance template if deviations occur.
All checks are executable using only canonical artifacts (no reliance on chat logs).
Templates avoid minting AT# and use only ATT-prefixed IDs.
Output JSON is schema-valid and contains templates, coverage_guidance, and definition_of_done arrays.
